61    #[DataProvider('providerReads')]
62    public function testReadsRetainAuditedSitesAndExplicitUncertainty(string $target, string $file, int $line, string $variable, array $expected): void
63    {
64        $path = dirname(__DIR__, 2).'/var/cache/wordpress-validation/7.1.1/wordpress/'.$file;
65        self::assertFileExists($path);
66        $graph = (new ExperimentAnalyzer(phpVersion: 70400))->inspect($path, $target);
67        $slice = Slice::of($graph, $graph->select($line, $variable), Direction::Uses, null);
68        self::assertFalse($slice->analysis->complete);
69        self::assertNotEmpty($slice->analysis->issues);
70        $lines = array_map(static fn (\App\Analyzer\ExperimentAnalyzer\Structure\Site $site): int => $site->source->line, $slice->structure);
71        self::assertSame([], array_values(array_diff(array_column($expected, 0), $lines)));
72        self::assertContains($line, $lines);
73    }

259     */
260    public function testLoopEarlyReturnCannotHideTheFinalReturnCondition(): void
261    {
262        $path = dirname(__DIR__, 2).'/var/cache/wordpress-validation/7.1.1/wordpress/wp-includes/functions.php';
263        $graph = (new ExperimentAnalyzer(phpVersion: 70400))->inspect($path, '_wp_check_alternate_file_names');
264        $backward = Slice::of($graph, $graph->select(2857, null), Direction::Uses, null);
265        $forward = Slice::of($graph, $graph->select(2846, 'filenames'), Direction::UsedBy, null);
266        self::assertFalse($backward->analysis->complete);
267        self::assertContains('FOREACH_PROTOCOL', array_column($backward->analysis->issues, 'code'));
268        self::assertContains(2847, array_column($backward->nodes, 'line'));
269        self::assertContains(2857, array_column($forward->nodes, 'line'));
270    }

286    /**
287     * Checks the two controlling source predicates on the extension assignment.
288     */
289    public function testFiletypeAssignmentKeepsTheForeachAndRegexConditionLines(): void
290    {
291        $path = dirname(__DIR__, 2).'/var/cache/wordpress-validation/7.1.1/wordpress/wp-includes/functions.php';
292        $graph = (new ExperimentAnalyzer(phpVersion: 70400))->inspect($path, 'wp_check_filetype');
293        $conditions = [];
294        foreach ($graph->edges as $edge) {
295            $from = $graph->nodes[$edge->from];
296            $to = $graph->nodes[$edge->to];
297            if ($from->line === 3091 && $from->kind === 'write' && $from->variable === '$ext' && $edge->kind === 'control' && in_array($edge->branch, ['iterate', 'truthy'], true)) {
298                $conditions[] = [$to->line, $edge->branch];
299            }
300        }
301        self::assertSame([[3087, 'iterate'], [3089, 'truthy']], $conditions);
302        self::assertContains('FOREACH_PROTOCOL', array_column($graph->issues, 'code'));
303        self::assertContains('OPAQUE_CALL', array_column($graph->issues, 'code'));
304        self::assertContains('LOOP_RECURRENCE', array_column($graph->issues, 'code'));
305    }
